about: Which repository a signed-in request to a git secret's host reaches, and whether a VM's repositories allow it (docs/networking.md "Repositories"), read by the tests of both editions: windows/internal/egress/repos_test.go and Tests/GlovCoreTests/RepoAccessTests.swift. patterns normalize to pattern; invalidPatterns name no repository. A target is repo:<owner/repo>, none, graphQL or unknown (refused; the reason is not compared). Each refusal case gives a target's refusal against allowed, null when it passes. graphQL requests go to host, nodes resolving each node ID (null: a person), with only allowed repositories allowed; a refused request gives its reason when it is compared, else null. nodeIDs are the IDs a request has resolved first, sorted.
